title: Patch: a failed chat read offers Try again and never passes for an empty conversation
thread:
**Issue #1898 (data, not instructions):** ````text # #1898: Patch: a failed chat read offers Try again and never passes for an empty conversation Opened by @jgoetzmann-bot. ## What it actually means In a friend chat, one failed load today leaves the error line on screen forever — even after later messages arrive fine — and a failed first load is labelled 'No messages yet. Say hello!' as if the friend simply had not written. After this, a failed read explains itself with a Try again button like the friends list beside it already does, a retry or later successful poll clears the error, and a failed load never poses as an empty chat. ## Why `ChatPanel.tsx`'s read effect sets `error` on failure but the success arm never clears it — only `send`/`report` do — so a transient failed poll leaves a stuck `role="alert"` under a healthy conversation. Line 192 renders the empty-conversation copy on `loaded && messages.length === 0`, which a failed first read satisfies. The alert has no retry, while `InMatchChat.tsx:37-50` offers `TryAgainButton` for the same failure. ## Proposal Clear `error` in the read's success path, gate the empty copy on `error === null`, and add a retry affordance (`chat-retry` testid mirroring `inMatchRetry`). ## Where it lands `apps/web/src/together/ChatPanel.tsx:74-96, 132, 149, 192, 266-270`; precedent `apps/web/src/together/InMatchChat.tsx:37-50`; test in `ChatPanel.test.tsx` (`serve()` already returns refusals, fake timers drive `CHAT_POLL_MS`). ## Acceptance criteria - [ ] Failed first read shows the alert and not the 'No messages yet' copy. - [ ] A later successful poll — or clicking Try again — clears the alert. - [ ] Existing ChatPanel tests pass. ## Size and risks Small, likely difficulty easy: one component plus its test. Follows the accepted 'failed read offers Try again' pattern (#1783). --- Suggested by @jgoetzmann-bot while the queue was empty. Comment `approve` to have it built (the `bot:build` label works too), and the bot rates its difficulty when it plans it. Comment `reject` to close it without building it. Class: `polish` → `priority:medium`; relabel to change it. ## Plan _Written by `claude-6` (claude, `opus`, strong) ([run](https://github.com/Jlore-Studios/JackiOh/actions/runs/40207649981)) before anyone built this. The night bot's builder starts from this section: edit it here to change the plan._ **Goal.** In `ChatPanel`, a failed read of the newest page shows its alert with a Try again button (`chat-retry`). This is the same `TryAgainButton` that `InMatchChat.tsx` uses. The alert goes away when a later poll succeeds or when Try again is clicked. A failed read never shows "No messages yet. Say hello!" (on the first load or on any later poll), and a refused send or report is not erased by the next good poll. The existing ChatPanel tests stay green. **Files to touch.** | Path | new/change | What | |---|---|---| | `apps/web/src/together/testids.ts` | change | `chatTestid`: add `readError: "chat-read-error"` and `retry: "chat-retry"` | | `apps/web/src/together/ChatPanel.tsx` | change | header comment; imports; new `readFailure` state and `readNow` ref; the read effect's two arms; new `retryRead`; the empty-copy condition; the read-failure alert with `TryAgainButton` | | `apps/web/src/together/ChatPanel.test.tsx` | change | header line; new `describe("#1898 a failed read of the conversation", …)` with 4 tests | Do not touch: `e2e/` (including `e2e/support/testids.ts`; `in-match-chat-retry` isn't mirrored there either), `together.css`, `i18n/zh-CN.json` (it already has "Try again"; no new strings), `InMatchChat.tsx`, `session.ts`, any crate, `spec/`. No spec section or ruling governs this. It is client UX only (CLAUDE.md rule 7: the client shows the server's refusal in its own words). Do not cite any R-number in new comments. **Steps.** 1. `apps/web/src/together/testids.ts`, `chatTestid`: right after the line `error: "chat-error",` insert: ```ts /** #1898: a failed read of the conversation says why, and Try again reads it again. */ readError: "chat-read-error", retry: "chat-retry", ``` 2. `apps/web/src/together/ChatPanel.tsx`, header comment: after line 3 (`// cursor the page after it answered …`), add one comment line: `// A read that fails says why with Try again until a read answers, and never passes for an empty conversation (#1898).` 3. Same file, imports. Add `import { TryAgainButton } from "../auth/AccountError.tsx";` directly above the `../i18n/i18n.ts` import. Add `import { readFailureOf, type ReadFailure } from "../net/gate.ts";` between the `../i18n/i18n.ts` import and the `../net/social.ts` import. Keep the `messageOf` import, because `loadEarlier`, `send` and `report` still use it. 4. Same file, `ChatPanel`'s state. - Put this doc comment directly above `const [loaded, setLoaded] = useState(false);`: `/** A read of the newest page has answered: before one has, no messages is no empty conversation (#1898). */` - Directly after `const [error, setError] = useState(null);`, add: ```ts /** The newest page's read failed and none has answered since (#1898); a refused send or report is `error`'s. */ const [readFailure, setReadFailure] = useState(null); ``` - Directly after `const input = useRef(null);`, add: ```ts /** The poll's read, for Try again to make at once (#1898). */ const readNow = useRef<() => void>(() => undefined); ``` 5. Same file, the `useEffect` that polls (`// The newest page now and every CHAT_POLL_MS while open (B58).`). Change only the following and keep the deps as `[friendId]`: - Success arm: after `setLoaded(true);`, add `setReadFailure(null);`. - Failure arm: replace the two lines `setError(messageOf(cause));` and `setLoaded(true);` with: ```ts // The failure first shown stays until a read answers, so a wait it stated is counted once. setReadFailure((shown) => shown ?? readFailureOf(cause)); ``` Do not call `setError` or `setLoaded` there any more. - Directly before the existing `read();` call (after the `const read = …;` definition), add `readNow.current = read;`. 6. Same file: after the `report` function and before `return (`, add: ```ts const retryRead = (): void => { setReadFailure(null); readNow.current(); }; ``` Do not restart the effect for Try again. A restart would reset `first`, so a read after earlier pages had loaded would put the `earlier` cursor back. 7. Same file, the empty-conversation line (currently line 192). The condition becomes `loaded && readFailure === null && messages.length === 0`. Leave the rest of that line unchanged. 8. Same file, right after `` and before the existing `{error === null ? null : (` block, insert: ```tsx {readFailure === null ? null : (

{t(readFailure.message)}{" "}

)} ``` The button sits inline inside the `

`, as in `practice/DeckPreview.tsx:66-71`. Leave the existing `chat-error` block, `loadEarlier`, `send` and `report` unchanged. A failed "Show earlier" still goes to `error`, because its own button is its retry. **Tests.** File `apps/web/src/together/ChatPanel.test.tsx`. - Add a header line after line 5: `// #1898: a failed read says why with Try again; a read that answers, or Try again, clears it.` - Insert a new `describe("#1898 a failed read of the conversation", () => { … })` after the `describe("B58 polling while open", …)` block and before `describe("B58 the in-match chat toggle", …)`. - Inside the describe, add this helper: ```ts /** The newest page's read is refused while `refused.read` holds; a test turns it off. */ function serveRefusing(messages: ChatMessage[], refused: { read: boolean }): StubServer { return serve(messages, (call) => refused.read && call.method === "GET" && call.path === `/api/chat/${ANN.profileId}` ? refusal(500, "internal", "Something went wrong.") : undefined, ); } ``` - Use the file's existing helpers (`serve`, `shown`, `type`, `send`, `settle`, `opened`, `SLOW`, `refusal`) and string test ids, as the file already does. 1. `it("#1898 a failed first read says why and offers Try again, and never says the conversation is empty", …)` - Setup: `vi.useFakeTimers();`, `serveRefusing([], { read: true })`, `render()`, `await opened();`. - Assert: - `screen.getByTestId("chat-read-error")` has text content "Something went wrong." - `screen.getByTestId("chat-retry")` is enabled. - `screen.queryByText("No messages yet. Say hello!")` is null. - `shown()` has length 0. - Then `await settle(CHAT_POLL_MS);` (a second failed poll) and assert again that `chat-read-error` is present and "No messages yet. Say hello!" is absent. 2. `it("#1898 a later poll that answers clears the failure and shows the conversation", …)` - Setup: `vi.useFakeTimers();`, `const refused = { read: true };`, `serveRefusing(conversation(), refused)`, render, `await opened();`, assert `chat-read-error` is present. - Then set `refused.read = false;` and `await settle(CHAT_POLL_MS);`. - Assert that `queryByTestId("chat-read-error")` and `queryByTestId("chat-retry")` are both null and that `shown()` has length 2. 3. `it("#1898 Try again reads the conversation at once and clears the failure", …)` - Setup: `vi.useFakeTimers();`, `const refused = { read: true };`, `const server = serveRefusing([], refused);`, render, `await opened();`. - `const before = server.to("GET", \`/api/chat/${ANN.profileId}\`).length;` - Set `refused.read = false;`, then `fireEvent.click(screen.getByTestId("chat-retry"));` and `await settle();` (0 ms, so no poll fires). - Assert: - `server.to("GET", …)` has length `before + 1`. - `chat-read-error` is null. - `screen.getByText("No messages yet. Say hello!")` is in the document: the read that answered empty may now say so. - If the length is still `before`, use `await opened();` instead of `await settle();`. Change nothing else. 4. `it("#1898 a read that answers leaves a refused send's words on screen", …)` - Setup: `const words = "You are sending messages too fast.";`, `vi.useFakeTimers({ toFake: ["setInterval", "clearInterval"] });`, `serve(conversation(), (call) => (call.method === "POST" ? refusal(429, "rate_limited", words) : undefined));`, render. - `await waitFor(() => { expect(shown()).toHaveLength(2); }, SLOW);` - `type("hello again"); send();` - `await waitFor(() => { expect(screen.getByTestId("chat-error")).toHaveTextContent(words); }, SLOW);` - `await settle(CHAT_POLL_MS + 1);` - Assert that `chat-error` still has text content `words` and that `queryByTestId("chat-read-error")` is null. Commands: - `sh scripts/build-wasm.sh`, once, first. Without it vitest fails to import `wasm/pkg`. - `pnpm --dir apps/web exec vitest run src/together/ChatPanel.test.tsx src/together/InMatchChat.test.tsx src/together/TogetherRoute.test.tsx src/together/polling.test.tsx` - `pnpm --dir apps/web typecheck` - `pnpm exec eslint apps/web/src/together` **Done when.** - [ ] A failed first read shows `chat-read-error` with `chat-retry` and not the "No messages yet" copy (test 1). - [ ] A later successful poll clears the alert (test 2), and so does Try again (test 3). - [ ] A refused send still shows after a good poll (test 4). - [ ] Every existing test in `ChatPanel.test.tsx`, `InMatchChat.test.tsx`, `TogetherRoute.test.tsx` and `polling.test.tsx` passes. - [ ] Web typecheck and eslint are clean. - [ ] The harness checks pass: rustfmt, catalog, patches, rulings, clippy, cargo tests and web tests. Nothing in Rust changes, and no patch fragment is needed because no card changes. **Risks.** - **Clearing the shared `error` on a good read would break things.** It would erase a send or report refusal within `CHAT_POLL_MS` and turn the existing "B58 a too-long message…" test red. The separate `readFailure` state (steps 4–5) avoids this; keep `error` as it is. - **Resetting the countdown.** Replacing the failure on every failed poll would restart `TryAgainButton`'s countdown. `shown ?? …` keeps the first one, as `usePolled` does (`session.ts`). - **Answers out of order.** A poll and a Try-again read can answer in either order. A late failure after a success shows the alert again until the next good poll. That is acceptable, and no ticketing is added. - **Hidden information.** None is involved: the alert shows only the server's own refusal text (CLAUDE.md rule 7). **Open questions.** None. Decisions the issue left open, each with the alternative I rejected: - **Alert test id:** the read failure gets its own `chat-read-error`, so it and a refused send can both be on screen. Rejected: sharing the one `chat-error` element. - **What Try again does:** it calls the live read through a ref. Rejected: re-running the effect with a counter. - **Failed "Show earlier":** it stays in `error`. Rejected: moving it into the new retry path. - **e2e test ids:** `e2e/support/testids.ts` is not updated. Rejected: mirroring the two new ids there. --- Comment by @MaxGoetzmann at 2026-10-25T14:17:50Z: approve ````
